issue_title: Allow greater control over the dimension of the SCI subspace
reason: SCI 子空间维度控制请求由 max_dim 实现直接完成；测试新增自旋扇区维度与 spin-square 断言，任务边界集中且具量子语义。

issue_title: diagonalize_fermionic_hamiltonian should also accept Numpy array of bools in place of BitArray
reason: 为 Executor 采样输出增加 NumPy bitstring 到经验概率与 SQD 对角化的完整输入路径；新增测试对 H2 求解能量与 CASCI 结果断言，改动对应单一需求。量子相关性为应用表示/执行接口层。

issue_title: Transform a docplex optimization problem into openQAOA Hamiltonian
reason: Docplex 优化问题到 QUBO/Ising Hamiltonian 的新转换直接满足 Issue；测试比较 MaxCut 映射项与系数。另引用 #41 经核实是同一 #36 请求的旧 PR，不是第二个独立需求。
新增自定义 RotationGateMap mixer block，直接实现超出 X/XY 的 mixer 请求；新增测试核对 Hamiltonian/gate-map 等价、系数分配与电路结构。

issue_title: Integrate ZNE from Mitiq into OpenQAOA
construction_risk: Unreachable expectation assertions; notebook runtime/kernel requirements; no established mitigation-accuracy oracle.
reason: Issue requests Mitiq ZNE integration; PR adds ZNE wrapper and workflow configuration. Added get_counts assertion exercises wrapper output; test_15_zne executes a notebook configuring Richardson scaling [1,2,3] and optimizing with mitigation. Retain under existing feature-test criterion, with weak-oracle/runtime caveat: test_expectation_zne returns before its assertions and notebook checks execution only. Issue remains OPEN; recovered through historical PR-first route.
Adds requested sparse matrix representation of Hamiltonian Pauli terms; added test compares the full complex 16x16 matrix to explicit expected entries.

issue_title: High-level methods need to be able to set feature map hyperparameters (e.g. num_qubits, num_layers)
construction_risk: Issue spans multiple ML classes; specification must clearly scope the QNN contribution without claiming all Issue62 functionality.
reason: Implements a coherent QNN portion of Issue62: high-level hyperparameter changes propagate qubit counts/layers/observable settings and reinitialize training parameter arrays. Added tests check single/multiple observable qubit consistency and successful fitting after changing circuit depth. Other PRs address kernel classes; this PR's QNN scope is attributable to the issue.

issue_title: QNN Class has no classification loss
reason: Adds missing classification objective to QNN, integrating expectation-output postprocessing and circuit/observable parameter gradients with cross entropy. Unit tests check loss/gradients and modified QNNClassifier tests exercise training with single and multiple observables. Retained as a core QML application API feature under the historical scope (not claiming cross entropy itself is quantum-specific).

construction_risk: Large cross-module patch; overlapping Issue292 must not count as an independent retained PR.
reason: PR main goal matches Issue266: deferred encoding-circuit and QML-model initialization infers feature dimension at fit time. Encoding-slot capacity/mismatch checks are explicitly discussed in Issue266; also closing related Issue292 does not add a clearly independent task. New circuit tests exercise dimension inference, slot mismatch and numerical kernel predictions.

issue_title: Adapatation of KernelOptimizer to squlearn standards
reason: Beyond reorganizing classes, adds user-visible automatic quantum-kernel parameter optimization when fitting high-level classifiers/regressors, with Fidelity/Projected kernels and NLL/target-alignment losses. New parametrized tests call fit and check optimized parameters/fitted state across five model classes.

Adds model persistence requiring reconstruction of Qulacs circuit/observable instructions and symbolic SparsePauliOp coefficients, plus executor reinjection. New round-trip tests preserve QNN numerical predictions and trainable circuit/observable parameters across backends; exceeds generic file I/O and directly targets core quantum-model behavior.

issue_title: optimized compiling for general QubitExcitations beyond single and double
construction_risk: Random-state test requires repeated runtime stability checks.
reason: Extends optimized QubitExcitation decomposition beyond single/double excitations. Added test checks lower circuit depth and unit state fidelity against Pauli decomposition for triple and five-fold excitations including random complex states.

construction_risk: Requires optional quimb; tests skip without it; confirm basis ordering and numerical stability at runtime.
reason: Adds circuit-to-unitary conversion using Quimb with variable binding and qubit-order mapping. New tests compare explicit three-qubit matrix and parameterized Pauli exponential to analytic matrices.

construction_risk: Requires PySCF; full Hilbert-space diagonalization cost and reference-state degeneracy/stability need runtime checks.
reason: Adds PySCF FCI determinant-to-qubit wavefunction conversion with interleaved spin orbitals and fermionic permutation phases. Added parametrized molecular tests check unit fidelity and energy equality against exact Hamiltonian diagonalization.
